dct_description_sm: This dataset applies across approximately 2,500 test conditions among two chemistries (NCA and LFP), four commercial cells, five temperatures (-20degC to 40degC), three pulse durations (2, 10, 30 seconds), varying operational histories, and the full service life from fresh cells to 80% SOH, this framework reveals a SOP landscape that is nonlinearly coupled to multiple factors and history-dependent.
dct_title_s: Battery State-of-power Measurement Dataset - Samsung 30T 3Ah, BYD Blade 135Ah, A123 APR18650M1A 1.1Ah, Tesla Panasonic 4.8Ah
